recommendations: DO NOT click, enter credentials, or submit OTP on this webpage.
If you entered information, immediately freeze your account via SBI helpline 1800-1234 or your netbanking portal.

scans.target_input: India Post Alert: Your parcel #IN889271 cannot be delivered due to incomplete street address. Update details within 12 hours at https://indiapost-parcel-tracking.vip or package will be returned to customs.
scans.sanitized_input: India Post Alert: Your parcel #IN889271 cannot be delivered... [URL redacted]

detected_signals.name: Urgency & Fear Induction
detected_signals.detail: Imposes artificial '12 hours' deadline to provoke impulsive clicking

detected_signals.name: Payment Phishing Trap
detected_signals.detail: Extracts small 're-delivery fee' of Rs 25 to capture credit/debit card details

recommendations: India Post never requests redelivery charges or address updates via unsolicited SMS links.
Legitimate tracking is available only at https://www.indiapost.gov.in.
Forward this SMS to 1909 (TRAI DND Fraud Reporting) and report on the Sanchar Saathi portal.

scans.target_input: Bijli bill update: Priye grahak, aapka bijli bill update nahi hua hai. Aaj raat 9:30 baje electricity supply disconnect ho jayegi. Turant electricity officer se sampark karein: 9876543210 ya link kholen http://bijli-bill-seva.in
scans.sanitized_input: Bijli bill update: Priye grahak... [Hinglish Disconnection Scam]

detected_signals.name: Utility Supply Threat
detected_signals.detail: Threatens power cutoff at '9:30 baje' to cause panic

detected_signals.name: Unauthorized Phone Contact
detected_signals.detail: Routes victims to a scammer's personal mobile number instead of DISCOM call center

detected_signals.name: Remote Access Trojan Vector
detected_signals.detail: Known to request installation of AnyDesk/TeamViewer/RustDesk under the guise of an APK

recommendations: Electricity distribution boards (DISCOMs) never send personal mobile numbers for bill payments.
Never install any APK or screen-sharing application (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) instructed over a phone call.
Verify your bill status directly on your official state electricity board portal or authorized app.

detected_signals.name: Suspicious TLD (.top)
detected_signals.detail: Frequently abused for rapid-disposal phishing lures

detected_signals.name: Credit Card Harvesting
detected_signals.detail: Requests direct payment without localized municipal gateway validation

recommendations: Do not enter payment details on stickers placed over municipal parking meters.
Use the official city parking application or pay at the physical terminal kiosk.

community_reports.description: Received SMS claiming my YONO netbanking was suspended due to unlinked PAN card. The webpage looked very identical to SBI official portal.
community_reports.evidence_text: SMS from CP-SBIBNK: 'Dear customer, your SBI account is blocked. Update PAN card at https://sbi-yono-update-kyc.org to resume services.'

community_reports.description: Claimed my parcel could not be delivered and asked for Rs 35 re-delivery fee. Upon clicking pay, requested full CVV and OTP.
community_reports.evidence_text: SMS: 'Your India Post parcel is stuck at hub due to incomplete house number. Update within 12 hours.'

community_reports.description: Caller claimed to be junior engineer from electricity board. Told me power will be cut in 30 minutes if I don't send bill receipt or download 'QuickSupport' app.
community_reports.evidence_text: Received multiple automated calls prompting to dial this number.
